title: Day, Night and Weather
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Day, Night and Weather Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe changes in a day, including day and night and the position of the Sun; describe daily weather and how people and animals respond to it. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand E: Earth and Space Systems – Daily and Seasonal Changes)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on day and night, the Sun in the sky and daily weather, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: At night our side of Earth faces away from the Sun. Weather changes every day.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every day has a morning, an afternoon, an evening and a night.

  • The Sun rises in the morning.
  • At night we see the Moon and stars.
  • Weather can be sunny, rainy, windy or snowy.
Example

When do we see stars?

the sky is dark

Answer: at night

Example

It is raining. What do you wear?

stay dry

Answer: a raincoat

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the Sun goes out at night.
  • Thinking weather is the same every day.

faq.q: Why do we have day and night?
faq.a: Earth spins. When our side faces the Sun it is day; when it faces away it is night.
What the air and sky are like: sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, snowy, hot or cold.
